From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tobias Meyer <tobias.meyer@stratusdata.com>, Anne Dupont <anne.dupont@stratusdata.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 13:14:00 -0700
Subject: Narrowing exec-friendly demo window and fallback plan

Hi Tobias / Anne —

Great to hear you’re ready for the executive-level walkthrough. We want to keep this tight (25–30 minutes) and make sure your C-suite can join the critical first 10–12 minutes. To cover US / EU / APAC exec availability, can you confirm which of the options below works best? I included local conversions to make it easier.

Option A — shorter US morning, EU afternoon, late APAC
• Tue Jul 18 — 08:00 PDT / 16:00 BST / 23:00 SGT

Option B — slightly later US, EU late afternoon, APAC late evening
• Wed Jul 19 — 09:30 PDT / 17:30 BST / 00:30 SGT (next day)

Option C — EU-first window (may be early US)
• Thu Jul 20 — 14:00 BST / 06:00 PDT / 21:00 SGT

A couple of notes:
- If this becomes a recurring sync we should agree a fallback plan for the October DST overlap; UK/EU and US switches create one-week windows where local times slip by an hour. I can propose a rotating scheme if you want avoid that pain.
- We suggest a 25-minute demo + 10-minute exec Q&A; if execs can only make the first 10 minutes we’ll front-load the high-level ROI and live perf numbers.

I’ve cc’d Hannah and Neha from our side for calendar/ops and exec attendance. Once you confirm a slot I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda (attaching a lightweight agenda draft).

Thanks —
Marcus
Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: Redwood_Demo_Agenda.pdf (1 page — draft agenda)

Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 09:48:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Narrowing exec-friendly demo window and fallback plan

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear options and the agenda. For our execs the best fit is Option C on Thu Jul 20 at 14:00 BST (which I see is 06:00 PDT). That’s early for our US counterparts but manageable if we keep it short — execs intend to join for the first 12 minutes and then hand off to engineering/product.

One ask: can we avoid slots that fall inside the UK DST switch weeks (we’ve had scheduling glitches in Oct previously)? If this becomes a recurring check-in they’d prefer a rotating scheme where leadership time is alternated so the same execs aren’t on at 03:00 local.

Also cc’d Anne who will own calendaring and access. Please send an invite and include dial-in / SSO link for Redwood's demo environment.

Best,
Tobias
SVP Product, Stratus Data
tobias.meyer@stratusdata.com

Subject: Re: Narrowing exec-friendly demo window and fallback plan

Looping internal exec availability — quick notes:

1) Rishi (CTO) can join the first 12 minutes on Thu Jul 20 but prefers no earlier than 07:00 PDT; 06:00 is borderline.
2) Neha can own the walkthrough if Rishi has to drop early; she’ll do the live perf block and hand to engineering.
3) To keep the meeting useful for Stratus execs, propose we trim to 25 minutes: 12-minute exec-level summary (value, TTFB/latency, unit cost delta), 10-minute demo (live load + failover) and 3-minute next-steps + ask.

If Tobias/Anne are fixed on 14:00 BST (06:00 PDT) can we offer a 06:00->06:25 start on our side but have Rishi join from 06:05->06:17 (i.e., he joins shortly after start)? Alternatively, ask them if Jul 18 08:00 PDT /16:00 BST (Option A) works — that is much friendlier for our US execs.

Also: I’ll generate a short dial-in/SSO checklist and add it to the calendar invite.

— Hannah

Thanks Tobias / Anne — confirmed for Thu Jul 20 at 14:00 BST / 06:00 PDT. I’ve set the meeting to 25 minutes and attached the agenda + calendar invite with the SSO join URL.

Practicals:
• Meeting length: 25 minutes (12m exec summary, 10m demo, 3m next-steps)
• Exec coverage: Rishi will aim to join 06:05–06:17 PDT; Neha will lead the demo if Rishi needs to drop early.
• Backup: if the meeting falls on an affected DST switch week we’ll follow the rotating fallback (Rishi: alternate weeks; ask Stack execs to rotate), details linked in the invite.
• Action items for Stratus: please confirm which execs will attend the first 12 minutes so we can tailor the opening ROI slides.

See attachments: Redwood_Demo_Agenda.pdf, Redwood_Demo_CalendarInvite.ics
